responsibility: Implements gm2’s deeper structural type checker for parameters, assignments, and expressions after symbol declarations are fully known. It builds temporary check-state records and pair graphs to compare types recursively, handling subranges, arrays, records, procedures, pointers, system types, constants, and special cases such as `IN` expressions, while caching visited/resolved pairs to avoid cycles and producing diagnostics through `M2Error`/`M2MetaError` when requested.
same_name_distinction: This `.mod` file is the implementation half of M2Check: it builds the internal pair/status graphs and recursive type-comparison machinery used to decide compatibility and issue diagnostics, while `M2Check.def` only exposes the top-level checking procedures.
